title: Michael's Big Night
logline: Michael hosts the annual Dundie Awards at Chili's and bombs until Pam, two margaritas in and with Roy at bowling, becomes his loudest fan, and kisses Jim on the cheek.
outline: A: Michael's Dundies at Chili's fall flat until one sincere award turns the room. B: Roy skips the Dundies; Pam gets tipsy, brave and happy, and kisses Jim on the cheek. C: Angela refuses to go in, but leaves Dwight a secret homemade Dundie in the parking lot. Order: cold, A, B, C, A, B, A, C, A, B, A, tag
storySoFar: At the Dundies at Chili's, Michael's jokes bombed and his 'Least Likely to Be Missed' award for Toby turned the room, until he gave Pam 'Most Likely to Become Famous' for her drawings (he keeps her sticky-note duck in a tie in his wallet). A tipsy Pam, with Roy at bowling, rallied everyone for Michael and kissed Jim on the cheek; the next morning she remembered nothing, and Jim didn't tell her. Angela skipped the Dundies but waited in the parking lot to give Dwight a secret homemade 'Most Loyal Employee' Dundie. Michael quietly gave Toby a 'Showed Up' award. Ryan is the temp; Kelly calls him Ry-Ry; Dwight suspects he's a corporate spy because of rumors that a branch will close.

stateChanges.progress: Pam kissed Jim on the cheek at the Dundies and doesn't remember; Jim didn't tell her
Angela gave Dwight a secret homemade Dundie in the parking lot

stateChanges.status: Michael was cruel at the Dundies, then gave Toby a 'Showed Up' award; still hates him

stateChanges.text: Michael keeps Pam's sticky-note drawing of a duck in a tie in his wallet
Dwight's secret Dundie: 'Most Loyal Employee', a soap bottle with a gold doll

scenes.recap: Michael rehearses his Dundies entrance with Dwight as the spotlight, which is a flashlight.

beats.caption: aims a heavy-duty flashlight at Michael's face

beats.text: Ladies and gentlemen. Your host. The man. The myth. The Dundie-maker.
Dwight, you have to follow me with the light. I'm moving.
I am following you. You are moving erratically. Like a moth.
Moths go TO the light, Dwight. That's the whole point of a moth.
Then you should be following ME.

scenes.recap: Michael announces tonight's Dundies at Chili's; nobody can get out of it.

beats.text: Tonight. Chili's. Seven o'clock. The Dundies. I've had the trophies since August. They're in my trunk. They're hot.
Is it mandatory?
Is love mandatory, Stanley? Yes. Yes it is.
Last year the Dundies went until eleven and Kevin cried.
I won 'Best Hair.' It was a lot.

lines: The Oscars have Billy Crystal. The Dundies have me.
Billy Crystal has never been to Chili's. That I know of. Billy, if you're watching, come to Chili's.

scenes.recap: Pam tells Jim Roy is skipping the Dundies for bowling; Jim offers to sit with her.

beats.text: Roy's not coming tonight. Bowling league. Semifinals. Apparently it's a whole thing.
Well, the Dundies are also a whole thing. Different thing. Worse thing.
You can sit with me. I'll explain the awards. I've studied the history.
Okay. But I'm getting the big margarita. The one with the umbrella.

lines: I don't usually drink at work things. I don't usually do a lot of things.
Tonight I might do a couple things.

scenes.recap: Angela announces she won't attend the Dundies; Dwight is visibly crushed and tries to hide it.

beats.text: I won't be attending. Chili's is a den of loud people and cheese.
Good. Fine. I don't care who attends. I'm not even here. I'm getting a stapler.
Your stapler's on your desk, Dwight.
A second stapler. For redundancy.

lines: I don't go to the Dundies. I don't need Michael to give me an award shaped like a man.
I'll be in my car. In the parking lot. For no reason.

scenes.recap: Michael opens the Dundies with a song and the first awards, to a room that would rather be eating.

beats.text: THE DUNDIES

beats.caption: sings 'Dun-dies, Dun-dies' to the tune of nothing in particular

beats.text: Our first award: Best Use of a Microwave. Kevin Malone! For the fish incident.
I didn't know it was fish. It was in a cake box.
Next. Longest Lunch Without Technically Leaving. Stanley Hudson!
I'm not getting up.

beats.caption: a waiter drops a fajita skillet somewhere

scenes.recap: Two margaritas in, Pam starts heckling for Michael instead of against him, and Jim loves it.

beats.caption: finishes a margarita with a tiny umbrella in it

beats.text: Woo! Microwave! Kevin, you earned that!
Who are you?
I'm Pam. Pam who has fun. Pam with an umbrella.
I like Pam with an umbrella.

lines: I've never seen her like this. She's not drunk. She's like... unlocked.

scenes.recap: Michael gives Toby the 'Least Likely to Be Missed' award and the room turns on him.

beats.text: And the Dundie for Least Likely to Be Missed goes to... Toby!
Thanks, Michael. I'll... put it with the others.
That was mean, Michael.
Boo.
I've been booed off better stages. Tijuana, 1979.
Okay. Tough crowd. Good. Comedians love a tough crowd. Dwight, the light.

beats.caption: aims the flashlight at Michael, who squints

scenes.recap: Dwight steps out for air; Angela, waiting in the parking lot, gives him a secret homemade Dundie.

beats.text: Angela. You're here. In the parking lot. For no reason.

beats.caption: hands him a trophy made from a soap bottle and a gold-painted doll

beats.text: Most Loyal Employee. I made it. Don't tell anyone. Don't look at me.
This is the greatest honor of my life. Second greatest. Third. It's in the top three.

lines: I received a private award tonight. From a private donor.
I will not be disclosing the donor. The donor is very private. And small. And perfect.

scenes.recap: Michael gives Pam 'Most Likely to Become Famous' for her drawings; it's sincere, she's moved, and she rallies the room behind him.

beats.text: This next one is... I mean it. Most Likely to Become Famous. Pam Beesly. For the drawings.
Me? You've seen my drawings?
The ones on the sticky notes. The duck in a tie. I keep it in my wallet.
Everybody! Michael has a duck in his wallet! Michael is the best boss! Woo!

lines: Every year, there's a moment at the Dundies when it all comes together.
This year it was Pam. And a duck. Mostly Pam.

scenes.recap: By the door, Pam thanks Jim for sitting with her and kisses him on the cheek; Jim stands frozen after she leaves.

beats.text: Thank you for sitting with me. Tonight was the best night. You're the best, Jim.

beats.caption: kisses Jim on the cheek, quickly

beats.text: Okay! I'm getting a cab. Roy says don't drive. Roy's so smart.

scenes.recap: Closing up, Michael quietly gives Toby a second, real award; Toby doesn't know what to do with it.

beats.text: LATER
Toby. I had a backup Dundie. 'Showed Up.' It's for showing up.
Michael, that's... really nice, actually.
Don't make it weird. It's still a worse award than everyone else's.
Can we go now?
I'm taking the extra fajitas.

scenes.recap: The next morning, Pam remembers the award and nothing else; Jim doesn't tell her.

beats.text: THE NEXT MORNING
I remember the duck. And the award. And then... nothing. Did I do anything embarrassing?
No. Nothing. You were great.
